notes:
Founder: Ari Mendoza (CTO / founder). Lead is very price-sensitive and founder-led — pulled in by product-led signup. Use case: in-app assistant + doc search for SMB SaaS (onboarding flows, knowledge base). Current prototyping with OpenAI; evaluating Redwood as lower-cost/low-latency hosted alternative. Key asks: 
- Clear per-token pricing bands for Hosted API (small, mid, burst tiers) and example math for 100k / 1M / 5M tokens/month.
- Rate limits and burst handling (need to support short spikes to ~2k concurrent users for limited windows).
- Latency targets: 150-300ms p95 for short chat turns acceptable; any streaming support?
- Model compatibility: wants ability to call familiar model families (gpt-like + smaller quantized variants); cares about quality parity vs current OpenAI baseline.
- Security: SMB-level SSO/SAML planned later; wants audit logs now. No air-gapped requirement, public cloud ok.

Founder quotes from call: "We love the self-serve flow but need to understand the real bill — comparing your numbers to OpenAI/Anthropic we want to see where we save."

Trial notes: signed up 3/1, used ~$150 credits; spike on 3/4 when embedding index built (approx 350k tokens). Prototype traffic profile: ~30k tokens/day now, expected to grow to 1M tokens/mo if product-market fit in next 2 months.

Next steps (short): send concise pricing table + token cost calculator (examples for 100k / 1M / 5M) + short note on throughput/rate limit tiers. Offer optional 30m demo to walk pricing and show latency benchmarks (can include p95 numbers from Hosted API). Blockers: pricing clarity, direct OpenAI/Anthropic comparison, clarity on per-request concurrency.

Referral / comps: currently testing OpenAI + Anthropic; founder asked whether Redwood can guarantee same output quality on open models and what fallback policies exist when capacity is constrained.
